watches.name: Vultura Halcyon Watch – Blue Mesh Metal
watches.description: The Vultura Halcyon combines elegant design with refined aesthetics in sapphire blue. Inspired by the majestic Halcyon bird, the case is presented in noble blue, reflecting the vibrant colors of the dial. The silver indices and hands capture the shimmering grace of the Halcyon, adding a subtle, lustrous touch to the watch. This timepiece blends tranquility with style, inviting you to savor special moments and appreciate the beauty of calm amidst chaos. A sophisticated accessory that embraces the elegance and serenity of the moment in a timeless design. See watch details below. Color: Blue, Silver Case diameter: 26mm Case thickness: 6mm Case material: 316L steel Dial color: Blue, Silver, Purple and Pink Glass quality: Mineral glass K1 (hardened) Calibration (movement): Quartz Miyota GL22 Water resistance: 3 ATM Warranty: 2 years

watches.name: Vultura Apyrit Watch – Rose Gold Mesh Metal
watches.description: The Vultura Apyrit combines exquisite rose gold with a bold red to create a watch that embodies both style and meaning. The name “Apyrit” is derived from the Greek word “apýritis,” meaning “without limits,” reflecting the boundless nature of human expression. The rose gold of the bracelet and case symbolizes warmth and connection, while the deep red of the dial conveys passion and intensity. Together, they embody an elegant fusion of confidence and emotional depth. The Vultura Apyrit is more than just a stylish accessory – it is an expression of personal strength and individuality. With its unique color palette and modern design, it makes a striking statement both in everyday life and at special occasions. See watch details below. Color: Rose Gold, Red Case diameter: 26mm Case thickness: 6mm Case material: 316L steel Dial color: Red Glass quality: Mineral glass K1 (hardened) Calibration (movement): Quartz Miyota GL22 Water resistance: 3 ATM Warranty: 2 years

watches.name: Vultura Sanguine Watch – Copper Mesh Metal
watches.description: The Vultura Sanguine captivates with its bold, trendsetting design and vibrant, passionate colors, perfectly embodying the essence of the brand. This eye-catching timepiece serves as an elegant and modern accessory that adds a touch of sophistication to any outfit. The watch’s dial stands out with its unique color blend. The warm copper and violet hues create striking reflections that highlight the watch’s design, making it truly distinctive. The Vultura Sanguine is more than just a watch—it’s a statement of individuality and style. With its artistic design and precise craftsmanship, it becomes a timeless companion for those who wish to confidently showcase their personality. See watch details below. watches.name: Vultura Aureate Watch – Brass Mesh Metal
watches.description: The Vultura Aureate embodies elegant restraint and refined boldness in one. At first glance, it captivates with its simple, golden aesthetic—a timeless accessory of pure sophistication. But with a second look, the extraordinary design is revealed: the distinctive vulva shape that gives this watch its unique charm. For those who wish to make a subtle yet daring statement, the Vultura Aureate is the perfect choice. A classic piece that offers more than meets the eye—ideal for those who love elegance with a hint of audacity. See watch details below. watches.name: Vultura Onyx Watch – Black mesh metal
watches.description: Let yourself be captivated by this unique design and choose the Vultura Onyx watch – a timepiece that will accompany you both in everyday life and at formal events. The distinctive bezel, delicate form, and flowing dial make it instantly recognizable, adding a touch of originality that elevates your look to extraordinary. The alluring dial, presented in various shades of black and subtly accented with fine gold lines, catches the light in a refined way and blends seamlessly with the rest of the watch. At the center, the two V-shaped hands reflect the inspiration of the ‘Vulva’ and the Vultura brand signature, symbolizing strength and individuality. See watch details below.
